summary_1line: Maricha warns Ravana that abducting Sita will bring destruction, praising Rama’s virtue and power while condemning Ravana’s reckless desire.

image_candidates.scene_text: Maricha stands before the enthroned Ravana in Lanka’s court, raising a warning hand while the demon king listens with dark pride.
Maricha warns that Sita, the daughter of Janaka, will become the fatal cause of Ravana’s destruction.
